name: Paired Operator-Trajectory Retention
scientific_trigger: V52 effect-support hurdle identified (AUC 0.6516244589283049, 5/5 folds > 0.5) while both conditional sign and Pareto order failed identification; execute the preregistered branch that acquires richer paired/on-policy treatment-control state rather than tuning the functional.
dominant_bottleneck: effectful selected-outcome state sufficiency: scalar operator dose identifies whether the frozen proposal changes closed-loop outcome, but not the direction/order of that change

frozen_contract.effect_support: exact V52 QPE+D zero-bias pairwise support hurdle, fixed lambda=1
frozen_contract.paired_outcome_labels: exact V50.5 metric-safe 502/502 one-shot treatment-control outcomes
frozen_contract.calibration: single split-conformal threshold on beneficial calibration events
frozen_contract.runtime_operator: same frozen RSMR winner or incumbent only; no rerank, no second best, no fallback

state_acquisition.role: TRAIN-only label-free state replay; paired outcome labels are not recollected or redefined
state_acquisition.event: exact V50 metric-safe frozen full-set RSMR intervention anchor before action execution
state_acquisition.objects: cached frozen proposal trajectory versus actual runtime incumbent trajectory
state_acquisition.engineering_identity_gate: 502/502 unique tokens and profile scalar L_inf must replay V51/V52 D token-by-token
state_acquisition.deployment_availability: same candidate proposal and incumbent trajectories already exist at runtime

arms.name: ENDPOINT
arms.question: Is directional terminal treatment-control geometry sufficient once effect support is frozen?

arms.name: TEMPORAL
arms.conditional_outcome_state: ENDPOINT plus fixed orthonormal DCT-II k=1,2 coefficients of signed dx(t),dy(t),dyaw(t),dv(t)
arms.question: If endpoint direction is insufficient, is minimal temporal treatment shape necessary?

identification_gates.effect_support_replay: exact V52 support AUC/fold signature must replay or ENGINEERING STOP
identification_gates.endpoint: aggregate conditional bad-outcome AUC > 0.5, > exact V52 scalar-hurdle conditional AUC, > exact V51 scalar conditional AUC; each comparison and >0.5 must hold in >=4/5 folds
identification_gates.temporal: same gates as ENDPOINT, plus aggregate AUC > ENDPOINT and TEMPORAL > ENDPOINT in >=4/5 folds to claim temporal necessity

deployment_gate: exact unchanged V50/V51/V52 paired causal retention gate after identification

branches.endpoint_pass: promote minimal signed terminal operator contrast; freeze immediately and use untouched paired validation
branches.only_temporal_pass: promote temporal operator-contrast state; claim temporal treatment shape is necessary beyond terminal direction
branches.state_identified_but_deployment_fail: state is sufficient for identification but low-capacity sign functional is deployment-insufficient; next algorithm may change structured paired functional but not add state
branches.both_fail_identification: close pre-execution operator-trajectory geometry as deployment-sufficient state; next evidence/state must be post-intervention paired dynamic response process

prohibited: D transform or D*QPE interaction sweep
trajectory horizon, cosine-mode count, basis, peak, early or threshold sweep
V46 handcrafted agent-occupancy temporal profile resurrection
safety scalarization or standalone catastrophe veto
